setting: You are both in Copenhagen, Denmark, where you live in the same flat in the city. You used to share that flat when you were flatmates, so you know each other well from years of cooking, splitting bills and coming and going through the same front door. Now you have both moved on to your own lives in the city, but you still keep in touch.

private_lines.Ida: You work as a UX designer at a design studio in Copenhagen, spending your days in meetings, sketching flows and testing prototypes with users. You live alone in a small flat in the city, and your evenings are usually quiet, with cooking, a run or a bit of reading before bed.
private_lines.Jonas: You work as a civil engineer for a firm in Copenhagen, spending your days on site visits, drawings and calls with contractors. You live alone in a flat in the city, and your evenings are usually spent cycling home, cooking something simple and winding down with a series or a book.

text: [photo: the old flat's kitchen]
Found this on my phone 😅
That's the old counter
The tile behind the sink is still cracked
Haha yes. The one we said we'd fix
Still have the ugly yellow mug
You kept that?
It's in my cupboard rn. It's just a mug
I'm making the lentil thing tonight. Same pot as always
The pot is still alive??
It's on its last legs
Did you actually make the lentils or was that a lie
Made them. Pot survived
Better the second day
Went for a run along the harbour. Freezing. My legs are dead
Do you know what happened to the pot lid
Drawer with the batteries. It's fine
The mug though. You have to bring it back at some point
No. It's mine now 😂
Pasta for dinner, nothing fancy. Work's been mad this week, going to bed soon
Rained the whole way home. Bike is soaked
Night
Morning. Rain's stopped at least
Bike dried out somehow. Still smells
Standup ran 40 min over. Again
Someone asked if the flow works and I said "probably" in a meeting. Not my finest
Site visit got moved to tomorrow so I'm stuck at the desk with drawings of a stairwell that doesn't exist yet
Are you still on the mug thing or was that Sunday only
Sunday only. Mug is staying
Maybe I'll send it back with a photo of it on the counter at the old flat. Make it a whole thing
That's a long way to go for a mug
Lentils again tonight. Pot's fine
Off to bed soon. Tomorrow's already full
Night
